title: epicrop
text: {epicrop} provides R package ‘EPIRICE’ model described Savary et al. 2012. Default values derived literature suitable modelling unmanaged disease intensity five rice diseases, bacterial blight (bacterial_blight()); brown spot (brown_spot()); leaf blast (leaf_blast()); sheath blight (sheath_blight()) tungro (tungro()) provided. model uses daily weather data estimate disease intensity. function, get_wth(), provided simplify downloading weather data via {nasapower} package (Sparks 2018, Sparks 2020) predict disease intensity five rice diseases using generic SEIR model (Zadoks 1971) function, SEIR(). Using package functions designed straightforward modelling rice disease risks, flexible enough accommodate pathosystems using SEIR() function. interested modelling pathosystems, please refer Savary et al. 2012 development parameters used rice diseases derived existing literature implemented individual disease model functions.
